editor.tabSize.description: Tab size. Number of columns a tab character occupies.

editor.indentSize.description: Indent size. Number of columns of one indentation level.

editor.insertSpaces.description: Indent with spaces. Pressing Tab inserts spaces instead of a tab character.

editor.detectIndentation.description: Detect indentation. Guesses the tab size and whether to indent with spaces or tabs from the opened file.

editor.wordWrap.description: Word wrap. Wraps long lines at the window edge.

editor.renderWhitespace.description: Show whitespace. Draws spaces and tab characters.

editor.fontFamily.description: Font family. Comma-separated list of font families, the first installed one is used.

editor.fontSize.description: Font size. Font size in points.

editor.fallbackFontFamily.default: Segoe UI Symbol, Segoe UI Emoji, Microsoft YaHei UI, Apple Symbols, Apple Color Emoji, PingFang SC, Noto Sans Symbols 2, Noto Color Emoji, Noto Sans CJK SC
editor.fallbackFontFamily.description: Fallback fonts. Comma-separated fonts tried for characters the main font does not have.

editor.renderLineEndings.description: Show line endings. Draws CR, LF or CRLF at the end of each line. The document is not changed.

editor.lineNumbers.description: Line numbers. Shows the column with line numbers.

editor.highlightCurrentLine.description: Highlight current line. Colors the line that holds the caret.

editor.links.description: Clickable links. Web addresses open with Ctrl+click.

editor.rightMargin.description: Right margin column. Draws a vertical guide after this many columns. 0 turns it off.

editor.minimap.description: Minimap. Shows a reduced picture of the text at the right edge; drag it to scroll.

files.encoding.description: Default encoding. Encoding used for new files and for files whose encoding cannot be detected.

files.eol.description: End of line. Line ending for new files. Auto uses the platform default.

files.trimTrailingWhitespace.description: Trim trailing whitespace. Removes spaces and tabs at line ends when saving.

files.insertFinalNewline.description: Insert final newline. Adds a line ending at the end of the file when saving.

files.showHidden.description: Hidden items in the Files panel. Off: the file panel leaves out entries that start with a dot or have the hidden attribute instead of dimming them.

files.gitStatus.description: Git status in the Files panel. File names in a Git repository get a colour and a letter by their state (modified, new, conflict).

files.autoSave.description: Auto save. Saves changed files to their own path.

updates.checkOnStart.description: Check for updates automatically. After start and then once a day it asks for a newer version and shows it in the status bar; nothing about you is sent.

remote.versionCheck.description: Check of the server version. By size and modification time (fast), or by content (slower, catches every change).

workbench.uiLanguage.description: Interface language. Language of menus and messages. Auto follows the system.

editor.autoClosePairs.description: Paired characters. Adds the closing character after a bracket or quote.

editor.continueComments.description: Continue comments. Enter inside a comment starts the next line as a comment.

workbench.theme.description: Theme. Light, dark or follow the system.

editor.colorTheme.description: Editor colour theme. Colours of the editor surface and the syntax highlighting; high contrast uses the system colours.

editor.themeColors.description: Custom colours. The chosen colours replace those of the theme in the editor, the preview and the export.

workbench.toolbar.description: Toolbar. Shows a row of buttons under the menu; pick them with View, Customize Toolbar.

workbench.toolbarLargeIcons.description: Large toolbar icons. The toolbar buttons show 24 px icons instead of 16 px.

workbench.toolbarColorIcons.description: Colored toolbar icons. Toolbar icons get a colour by the kind of command; in high contrast they stay single-coloured.

files.journalDirectory.description: Journal folder. Where unsaved work is written continuously for crash recovery. Empty: the profile folder.

history.enabled.description: Keep local history. Keeps a revision of a file at every save and at every change made outside the editor.

history.storeSecretFiles.description: Keep history of secrets files. On: also keeps revisions of files such as .env, whose values then lie on disk as plain text.

files.secretFilePatterns.description: Secret files. Name masks of the files whose values are hidden, separated by semicolons; * stands for any text and ? for one character.

history.maxRevisionsPerFile.description: Revisions per file. The oldest revisions beyond this number are deleted; pinned ones stay. 0: no limit.

history.maxAgeDays.description: Keep revisions for (days). Older revisions are deleted; the newest and pinned ones stay. 0: no limit.

history.maxMiBPerFile.description: History size per file (MiB). The oldest revisions beyond this size are deleted; the newest and pinned ones stay. 0: no limit.

history.maxTotalMiB.description: History size in total (MiB). When exceeded, the oldest unpinned revisions are deleted first. Pinned ones stay even if the limit cannot be met. 0: no limit.

files.journalFallbackDirectory.description: Journal fallback folder. Used when the main journal folder cannot be written. Empty: the system temp folder.

files.relatedFileRules.description: Related file rules. Pairs of endings that belong together, for example .vert|.frag;.scss|.css; they come before the built-in ones.

files.largeFileThreshold.description: Large file threshold (MiB). A file above this size opens in the paged mode, which edits the file in place without loading the whole text.

search.regexTimeoutMs.description: Regular expression time limit (ms). After this time an expression with backreferences or lookaround stops; other expressions have no limit.

tools.diffTool.description: External diff tool. Path of a program that compares two files. Empty: Compare with Disk opens the built-in comparison.

tools.diffArguments.description: Diff tool arguments. Argument template; {left} is the file on disk, {right} the content of the tab.

compare.ignoreWhitespace.description: Ignore whitespace when comparing. Lines that differ only in spaces or tabs (anywhere in the line) count as equal when texts are compared.

compare.ignoreCase.description: Ignore case when comparing. Lines that differ only in letter case count as equal when texts are compared.

git.gutter.description: Show Git changes in the gutter. The left margin marks lines changed against the index; a click on a mark stages or unstages the change.

git.gutterBase.description: Compare the Git changes in the gutter with. The marks in the margin show the difference to the index, or to the last commit.

git.blame.description: Show who changed the line at the caret. The status bar shows the author and date of the commit that last changed the line at the caret.

git.pullMode.description: Git Pull combines the changes by. How an update joins your commits with the new ones when the git configuration says nothing: ask, merge or rebase.

git.autoFetchMinutes.description: Git: fetch in the background every (minutes). After how many minutes git fetch runs in the background so the status bar shows incoming commits; 0 turns it off.

git.commitSaveAll.description: Save all before a commit. The choice of the commit panel, remembered: before a commit every unsaved document is saved, with its save actions.

git.commitFormat.description: Format the open files before a commit. The choice of the commit panel, remembered: the open files of the commit are brought to what .editorconfig says before the commit.

tools.makeProgram.description: Make program. Program that runs the targets of a Makefile. Empty: make. Use mingw32-make or a full path when make is not in PATH.

tools.timeoutSeconds.description: Default time limit of tools (seconds). After how many seconds a tool without a limit of its own is stopped; 0 lets it run.

tools.outputEncoding.description: Default output encoding of tools. Encoding the output of a tool is read in when its definition names none, for example utf-8, windows-1250 or ibm852. Empty: utf-8.

editor.profile.description: Behaviour profile. Keys and editing behaviour: the default set or the one that follows PSPad.

editor.enhancedHomeEnd.description: Smart Home and End. Home jumps between the first non-blank character and the line start, End between the last non-blank character and the line end.

editor.backspaceUnindent.description: Backspace in indentation. Backspace at the end of the indentation removes spaces back to the previous tab stop.

editor.altDragMode.description: Alt+drag. What dragging with Alt held makes: one caret per row, or a block selection.

editor.pairStyle.description: Pair rules. Rules for adding closing brackets and quotes: the default ones or the ones of PSPad.

editor.smartKeys.renameTag.description: Rename paired tag. Editing the name of an HTML or XML tag changes the matching tag too.

editor.smartKeys.closeTag.description: Complete closing tag. Typing </ after an open tag adds its name and the closing bracket.

editor.smartKeys.escapeInString.description: Escape on paste into a string. Pasted quotes and backslashes are escaped inside a string literal.

editor.smartKeys.jsonComma.description: Commas in JSON. Enter at the end of a JSON value adds the missing comma when another value follows.

editor.smartKeys.phpArrow.description: Arrow after a PHP variable. Typing - right after a PHP variable adds ->.

editor.smartKeys.selectVariable.description: Select PHP variable without $. A double click on a PHP variable selects its name without the dollar sign.

editor.smartKeys.sqlEnd.description: Close BEGIN with END. Enter after BEGIN in SQL adds a matching END line.

editor.emmet.description: Emmet on Tab. Tab expands an Emmet abbreviation in HTML and CSS; off, it only indents.

files.binaryAsHex.description: Binary files in hex. What happens when a file has a NUL byte in its first 8,000 bytes: ask with a bar, always open in hex, or never switch.

files.imageOpen.description: Picture files. Whether a picture opens as a picture, as text or in hex.

markdown.defaultMode.description: Default Markdown mode. Whether a newly opened Markdown file opens for reading, for editing with a preview or as source.

markdown.readerMaxWidth.description: Maximum text width of the Markdown reader (px). The widest column of text in reading and preview; 0 follows the width of the window.

editor.clipboardHistorySize.description: Clipboard history size. How many copied texts the clipboard history keeps until the program closes.

editor.dateTimeFormat.description: Date and time format. .NET custom format, for example yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm. Used by Insert Date and Time; month and day names follow the interface language.

sql.dialect.description: Default SQL dialect. Dialect of SQL files that neither the file nor the folder sets. Folder: sql_dialect in .editorconfig.

schema.mappings.description: Schema mappings. MASK=SCHEMA rules that give a file its schema (the help topic on schemas describes the syntax).

html.tidyPath.description: HTML Tidy program. Full path of the HTML Tidy program. Empty: the editor looks next to the formatters plugin, in tools/tidy and in PATH.

hex.wildcardMaxBytes.description: Longest wildcard * in hex search (bytes). The most bytes a * may stand for in a hex search; 0 means 256.

hex.structureTemplates.description: Structure template per file type. The structure template for an extension, for example bin=elf_file; the Structure panel writes it.

web.searchUrl.description: Web search address. The address Search Selection on the Web sends the text to in place of {query}; empty turns the command off.

web.pathMap.description: Path to address rules. folder=>address rules from which Open File at Its Address builds the address.

files.decompileAssemblies.description: Decompile .NET assemblies on open. A .dll, .exe or .winmd file with .NET code opens as decompiled C# in a read-only tab. When off, it opens like any binary file.

plugins.catalogUrl.description: Plugin catalog source. The https address of the Git repository (or a folder) that holds the plugin catalog the command Tools, Plugin Catalog opens. Empty turns the catalog off.

spell.enabled.description: Spell checking. Underlines mistakes in comments, strings, Markdown and plain text.

spell.dictionary.description: Spelling dictionary. The path of the .dic file of a Hunspell dictionary; the .aff file of the same name must lie beside it. The command Choose Dictionary or the download of a dictionary sets it.

spell.autocorrect.description: Autocorrect diacritics. While you type, completes the diacritics of a word the dictionary knows in one form with diacritics. Works only with spell checking on; Undo gives the word back.

scripting.enabled.description: Scripts in the editor (prototype). Allows the command Run Script on Selection (JavaScript without access to the system).

appearance.iconSkin.description: Icon set. The built-in vector icons, or a folder of your own icon pictures. Empty means the built-in icons.

plugins.sandbox.description: Restrict plugin processes. Plugin processes run with system restrictions; takes effect at the next start of the plugin.

terminal.shell.description: Terminal shell. The program of the Terminal panel; empty means PowerShell on Windows and $SHELL elsewhere.

editor.clipboardMonitor.description: Collect copies from other programs. Adds texts copied in other programs to the clipboard history too.

review.autoKeep.description: Keep changes from outside without review. A tab without unsaved edits takes an outside change at once, without review.

advanced.scrollPastEnd.description: Scroll past the end of the text. Lets the last line scroll up to the top of the editor, leaving empty space below the text.

advanced.cutCopyWholeLine.description: Cut and copy the whole line without a selection. With nothing selected, Cut and Copy take the line of the caret including its line break.

advanced.hideMouseWhileTyping.description: Hide the mouse pointer while typing. The mouse pointer disappears over the text while you type and returns when you move the mouse.

advanced.linkNeedsCtrl.description: Open links only with Ctrl+click. On: a link opens with Ctrl+click. Off: a plain click opens it. Applies only when links are turned on.

advanced.wrapIndent.description: Indent of wrapped lines (columns). How many columns the continuation of a wrapped line is indented, on top of the indentation of the line itself. Applies with word wrap on.

advanced.recentFilesCount.description: Recent files kept. How many recent files Open Recent and Ctrl+P remember; 0 none.

advanced.autosaveIntervalSeconds.description: Autosave interval (seconds). How often a document with changes is written to its own file when Autosave is on.

advanced.caretBlinkMilliseconds.description: Text cursor blink time (milliseconds). How long the text cursor stays on and then off while it blinks. 0 keeps it on without blinking. The usual value is 500.

advanced.smoothScrolling.description: Smooth scrolling with the mouse wheel. The text glides to where the mouse wheel moves it instead of jumping there. Moving the scroll bar or the caret ends the glide at once.

advanced.undoLimit.description: Undo steps kept per document. The most undo steps a document keeps; 0 keeps all.

advanced.highlightMaxLines.description: Lines colored around the screen. How many lines around the screen are coloured at once; a lower number helps a slow computer.

advanced.highlightMaxColumns.description: Columns colored in a line. The most characters of a line the syntax colors are worked out for in one go, around the part on screen. A lower number spares a slow machine on very long lines.

editor.matchBrackets.description: Highlight matching brackets. Colors the bracket next to the caret and its partner. Brackets in strings and comments do not count.

editor.occurrences.enabled.description: Highlight other occurrences of the selection. Text selected on one line is highlighted at its other places too, and the status bar counts them.

editor.occurrences.wholeWord.description: Occurrences: whole words only. Highlights the selected text only where it is a whole word, so a selected word does not mark the longer words that contain it.

editor.occurrences.matchCase.description: Occurrences: match case. Highlights only text with the same upper and lower case letters as the selection.

editor.occurrences.atCaret.description: Occurrences: word under the caret. With nothing selected, highlights the other occurrences of the word the caret stands in. Only whole words are marked.

editor.occurrences.minLength.description: Occurrences: shortest selection. The fewest characters a selection must have before its other occurrences are highlighted.
